description:
Activate or deactivate every access rule on a node at once.

Activating enforces every rule within about 10 seconds: active IP rules
limit which IPs can call the node, active origin rules limit which Origin
headers it accepts, and a request must pass both kinds. Others get HTTP
403. First confirm with the user that the IP rules cover every IP that
calls the node (servers, CI, their own machine); you can't check this.
Origin rules block every request without an Origin header (servers,
scripts, curl), even from an allowed IP. Deactivating opens the node to
any IP and origin.
name: set_node_access_rules_status
